coverage: November 21–22, 2026 · Pacific time · 4 verified weekend picks

stories.title: OpenRouter removes providers after data-handling findings
stories.summary: OpenRouter says it off-boarded three providers, removed 125 endpoints from zero-data-retention eligibility and notified potentially affected customers. The findings concern upstream providers and do not show a breach of OpenRouter itself.
stories.insight: For enterprise workflows, trace the actual provider route, endpoint privacy settings and relevant incident notices.

stories.title: Sarvam releases a new 105B checkpoint for high-volume agents
stories.summary: Sarvam released 105B-1711 with BF16 and NVFP4 weights, targeting customer support, voice agents, tool use and Indian languages. Existing sarvam-105b API IDs now use the new weights without changing request formats.
stories.insight: Evaluate multi-turn instruction following, tool-call success and cost on the languages and tasks the business needs.

stories.title: Tencent Hy4 becomes available on Ollama Cloud
stories.summary: Ollama announced Hy4 on its cloud service with image understanding, tool use and long-context support, accessible as hy4:cloud. Ollama describes the service as U.S.-hosted with zero data retention.
stories.insight: Test a screenshot-based office task and measure tool use, task completion, cost and human corrections together.

stories.title: OpenAI proposes shared safety limits informed by perplexity
stories.summary: Chief scientist Jakub Pachocki shared OpenAI pretraining measurements and proposed common development limits informed by perplexity and other metrics. The essay discusses comparability and post-training limitations. This is a proposal rather than an adopted industry standard.
stories.insight: Distinguish pretraining metrics, downstream capabilities and acceptance tests for the work a model will actually perform.
